cases.name: hash.lua matches plan.py fingerprints
plan.lua matches plan.py on every decision vector
AUDIT on the before state writes nothing and reports each transaction
APPLY writes the hierarchy transaction only
second APPLY writes sources, third writes nothing
the engine waits between source writes
ROLLBACK undoes sources first, then the hierarchy
an unknown source hash blocks the whole run
a prior source hash is accepted and rewritten
a prior created module is rewritten in the hierarchy run
an instance without the install mark blocks create
an edited created module blocks APPLY and ROLLBACK
ROLLBACK refuses when a created instance has children it did not create
ROLLBACK refuses when an attribute was edited since
an earlier value of this delivery (was) is replaced by APPLY
a served source that does not match its hash blocks before any write
a source that cannot be fetched blocks APPLY and only warns in AUDIT
an after-source with a syntax error blocks (needs loadstring)
a failure while writing sources restores the sources already written
a failure while writing the hierarchy removes created instances and restores values
a write that does not take effect fails the post-write check and is undone
APPLY refuses while the sandbox test window is open
ROLLBACK is allowed while the test window is open
wrong place or not Edit blocks every mode
an op declared in the wrong transaction is refused
a phase marked not installable can be audited but not applied
two instances with one name make the path ambiguous
the Classic verify hook runs a fetched read-only script (needs loadstring)
the report encodes to JSON
the fake tree never reached the DataModel
